name: Self Indulgence
overview: Scripture presents self indulgence as a pursuit marked by excessive focus on personal pleasure and material abundance, as seen in Solomon's open enjoyment of all his desires in Ecclesiastes 2:10. The parable of the rich fool in Luke 12:16 illustrates the folly of hoarding wealth without regard for spiritual priorities. Likewise, the rich man who feasted sumptuously every day in Luke 16:19 exemplifies the danger of living in luxury while neglecting eternal realities.
